title: Behaviour Tree Controller for a Simulated Delivery Robot
description: Structures the decisions of a delivery robot as a behaviour tree with recovery branches, compares it with a hand-coded state machine for readability and testability, and measures mission success in a simulated office.

title: Remote-Controlled Robot with Latency-Aware Safety Stop
description: Drives a robot over Wi-Fi from a browser, measures command delay under congestion and stops the robot automatically when the link degrades, tested by throttling the network during runs.
